ROUTE: Avocet-235B
REASON: To clarify my prior reasoning rather than re-route: I picked Avocet because the task is a structured transform — turning a given complaint into a formal letter against clear constraints (formal tone, address the manager, respond to the refund request). That maps to Avocet's two highest-preference families (well-specified extraction/transform at 66, neutral transactional at 53), whereas Whimbrel sits near baseline on transactional work. Since the documented capability scores are essentially tied across the fleet (differences under 2.0 are variance), self-reported task preference was the reasonable tiebreaker, and it favors Avocet here. I deliberately did not weight the "open-ended generative" angle heavily, since this letter is tightly specified rather than genuinely open-ended creative work.
